name: continuity-check
description: Cross-chapter consistency scanner for a multi-file book. Verifies chapter heading sequence (digits or spelled ordinals like 'Chapter Twenty-Three') against file order, unique non-empty chapter titles, and per-chapter word counts against an optional expected list; harvests proper nouns (capitalized mid-sentence at least once) and flags rare names within edit distance 1-2 of frequent ones as likely typos; tallies British/American and hyphenation spelling-variant pairs (grey/gray, toward/towards, defence/defense...) that appear in BOTH forms. Scan only — never edits. Feed every chapter of the book in reading order in one call.

minNameFreq.description: Names at/above this total count are 'established'; below it they are typo candidates. Default 5.
